WITH kinnaur AS (
    SELECT id, geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE subtype = 'county'
      AND names."primary" = 'Kinnaur'
      AND region = 'IN-HP'
)
SELECT d.id,
       d.names."primary" AS name,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') d

  ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, k.geometry)
WHERE d.subtype = 'county'
  AND d.id <> k.id;

```sql
-- Find the geometry of Mahisagar (county)
WITH target AS (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM divisions_area
    WHERE id = 'ad62e34f-5214-4569-9094-61469389caee'
),

-- Find all regions (states/union territories) that touch Mahisagar
neighbors AS (
    SELECT
        d.id,
        d.names."primary" AS name,
        ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geometry) AS geometry
    FROM divisions_area d
    JOIN target t
      ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, t.geometry)          -- share a boundary
    WHERE d.subtype = 'region'                        -- state or union territory
      AND d.id <> 'ad62e34f-5214-4569-9094-61469389caee'  -- exclude Mahisagar itself
)

SELECT id, name, geometry
FROM neighbors;
```
